_source: 2300AD Core Book 1, chargen extract, printed pp9-10 (pdf 3-4). printed = pdf + 6.
_MY_ERROR: I omitted the UPP and UCP columns when transcribing the Colonies table, calling them 'world-generation data a character generator does not need'. That was WRONG. TECH LEVEL is the last character of the UPP and it drives the Homeworld Pre-Career Admissions DM; TIER drives both the Off-World Admissions DM and the ban on space careers in term one. Neither is derivable from what I kept. colonies.json must be re-transcribed to carry tech_level and tier before the education step can be built.
creation_order: note the homeworld Survival DM and adjust characteristics for Gravity Type
optionally attempt Pre-Career Education with the homeworld modifier
enter a career, then proceed as normal -- BUT make a Leaving Home check at the end of every term until it passes

frontier.dnams: Travellers from the Frontier may have DNA Modifications and Symbionts to cope with Planetary Adaptation Syndrome, noted in their colony's description. Travellers from outposts and other low- to zero-gravity environments can also select the Zero-Gee DNAM.

augmentation.trigger: each time a Survival roll is EQUAL TO the minimum required
augmentation.effect: the Traveller may elect to gain a prosthetic -- a limb, or one or both eyes
augmentation.quality: a cosmetic replacement with no special features unless later upgraded
augmentation._note: This hooks on an EXACT success, not a pass. The engine must compare total == target, not total >= target, and offer a choice at that moment.

pre_career_education.choice: on the homeworld, or off-world for better opportunities
pre_career_education.offworld_cost: a Traveller who successfully goes off-world for education suffers DM-1 to Benefit rolls when mustering out, and a roll of 1 then yields NO benefit at all

frontier.survival: the colony's Survival modifier applies until the Traveller leaves the homeworld
frontier.careers: all careers are available, EXCEPT that Travellers from Tier 5 or Tier 6 colonies cannot take a space-based career (Scout, Merchant, Navy) in their first term

spacer._education_note: Higher education is rare in Spacer societies; most learning is done on the job.
spacer.careers: all careers except Army are available in the first term; Army is available from the second term onwards and suffers DM-1 for entry
spacer.gun_combat: gun combat skills are almost unknown in the civilian Spacer population

Soft.extras: may start with DNA modifications and their associated Traits, symbionts and perhaps a Neo protector

path_effects._note: Path comes from the colony, not from player choice -- see colonies.json.

languages.secondary: if the nation or colony has one, skill level 1
languages.zhargon: Libertines and Belters know Zhargon at skill level 1
languages.arm_language: Frontier colonists have a passing knowledge (level 0) of the primary language of their arm: French in the French Arm, English in the American Arm, Mandarin Chinese in the Manchurian Arm
languages.checks: no check is normally needed at level 0+; technical discussion or relaying orders under stress may need one, at the referee's discretion

leaving_home.when: at the end of each term of a career, until it passes
leaving_home.on_success: the homeworld Survival modifier stops applying and the check is no longer made; the Traveller does not return during character generation
